decision: Close the ten-case E1 confirmation SUCCESS after 40 attributable initial/replay cells: 20 valid-control accepts and 20 expected boundary-specific rejects, with no unexpected behavior. Retain the portable exact-profile package and select CHECKED-IMPORT-REGRESSION-PACK-1 READY and unstarted because the named manual upgrade consumer is now feasible and needs separate fail-closed E2 integration. Keep ASSURANCE-CLAIM-DISPOSITION-1 READY as an independent visibility output. No defect, external action, current-tip claim or milestone change follows.

categories.assessment: The E1 result validates the bounded known-case method and directly enables its separately gated E2 consumer. The assurance companion remains a distinct evidence-reconciliation method without checker execution.

The exact manifest, raw receipts, replay and portable image are ready for guarded integration; they do not resolve missing historical eta/recursor custody. The assurance companion can make those unknowns legible without relabeling them.

A single fail-closed manual upgrade command realizes immediate local maintenance value while the exact runtime/archive remains available. No upstream write is supported. The companion separately improves public-status interpretation.

Reuse the unchanged confirmed bytes, adapters, supervisor and classification contract; no new method or literature search is needed for the bounded integration. The companion reuses the canonical assurance snapshot and evidence ledger.

Confirmation success removed the integration dependency and old-container blocker. Both candidates are locally feasible; integration ranks first as the direct result-driven completion of the named consumer, not because the companion is blocked.

candidates.rationale: Selected READY and unstarted. E1 success supplies the exact known-case basis and portable profiles; an independently reviewed fail-closed command is the shortest path to the named maintenance consumer. E2 controls and full closure remain mandatory.

Retain READY and unstarted as the next independent visibility output. It can account for all published cases without checker execution, but it does not realize the just-confirmed regression consumer as directly as E2 integration.
